title: Format prices for receipts
notes: Synthetic change to the demo shop with seeded defects.

defects.summary: Cents below 10 lose their leading zero: 105 cents prints as €1.5.
defects.caught_if: a condition formats an amount whose cents part is below 10 and checks two decimals are shown

defects.summary: Negative amounts are formatted wrongly: divmod floors, so -150 prints as €-2.50.
defects.caught_if: a condition formats a negative amount and expects -€1.50
